codeEditor.syntaxError: Tooltip of a red underline in the code editor when the code cannot be parsed.
codeEditor.phrases: Interface text of the code editor library (code folding, find and replace, diagnostics, comparison of two texts). Short labels in lower case stay in lower case.
codeEditor.phrases.foldLine: Tooltip of the arrow in the gutter that collapses a block of code.
codeEditor.phrases.unfoldLine: Tooltip of the arrow that expands a collapsed block.
codeEditor.phrases.foldedLines: Announced to screen readers after collapsing code.
codeEditor.phrases.unfoldedLines: Announced to screen readers after expanding code.
codeEditor.phrases.foldedCode: Accessible name of the marker that stands for collapsed code.
codeEditor.phrases.unfold: Tooltip of the marker that stands for collapsed code.
codeEditor.phrases.completions: Accessible name of the list of suggestions while typing.
codeEditor.phrases.controlCharacter: Tooltip of a non-printing character shown as a symbol.
codeEditor.phrases.diagnostics: Heading of the panel that lists problems found in the code.
codeEditor.phrases.noDiagnostics: Shown in that panel when there are none.
codeEditor.phrases.goToLine: Label of the Go to line box of the editor.
codeEditor.phrases.go: Button of the Go to line box.
codeEditor.phrases.close: Button that closes the find, replace or go to line panel.
codeEditor.phrases.find: Placeholder of the search field in the editor.
codeEditor.phrases.all: Button that selects all matches of the search.
codeEditor.phrases.byWord: Option label: match whole words only.
codeEditor.phrases.matchCase: Option label: match upper and lower case exactly.
codeEditor.phrases.next: Button: go to the next match.
codeEditor.phrases.previous: Button: go to the previous match.
codeEditor.phrases.regexp: Option label: treat the search as a regular expression.
codeEditor.phrases.currentMatch: Announced to screen readers for the match that is selected.
codeEditor.phrases.onLine: Announced after a match: found on line N.
codeEditor.phrases.to: Announced between two positions of a range, as in from 3 to 7.
codeEditor.phrases.selectionDeleted: Announced to screen readers after the selected text was deleted.
codeEditor.phrases.replacedMatches: Announced after replace all; {{count}} is the number of matches.
codeEditor.phrases.replacedMatchOnLine: Announced after replacing one match; {{line}} is a line number.
codeEditor.phrases.unchangedLines: Shown in a comparison for a stretch of lines that are the same in both texts.
codeEditor.phrases.accept: Button in a comparison that keeps a change.
codeEditor.phrases.reject: Button in a comparison that discards a change.
codeEditor.phrases.revertChunk: Tooltip of the button that undoes one block of changes.
